passive.name: Relentless Assault
passive.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

spells.name: Leap Strike
spells.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.
spells.tooltip: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> if it is an enemy.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Empower
spells.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.
spells.tooltip: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or <spellName>Leap Strike</spellName> to deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Counter Strike
spells.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Jax enters a defensive stance for up to {{ dodgeduration }} seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking {{ aoedamagereduction }}% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After {{ dodgeduration }} seconds or Recasting, Jax deals {{ totaldamage }} + {{ percenthealthdamage }}% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for {{ stunduration }} second.

The damage is increased by {{ percentincreasedperdodge*100 }}% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of {{ maxdamage }} + {{ maxpercenthealthdamage }}% max Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
spells.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Every third Attack within {{ passivefallofftime }} seconds deals an additional {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage.

Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing {{ swingdamagetotal }} magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains {{ basearmor }} Armor and {{ basemr }} Magic Resist plus {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and {{ bonusmr }} Magic Resist per additional champion hit for {{ duration }} seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Relentless Assault
effects: Innate: Jax's basic attacks generate a stack of Relentless Assault on-attack for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire by one every 0.25 seconds when the duration ends.
Relentless Assault: For each stack, Jax gains 5% : 12.5% (based on level) bonus attack speed, up to a maximum of 40% : 100% (based on level).

Grandmaster at Angling: While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, Jax will occasionally catch a fish, granting him 1 and 1 ability power for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a rare fish that grants 10 and 10 ability power for 5 seconds.

variants.name: Leap Strike
effects: Active: Jax dashes to the target unit's location.
Jax can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

variants.name: Empower
effects: Empower resets Jax's basic attack timer.

variants.name: Counter Strike
effects: Active: Jax enters Evasion for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to dodge all incoming non- turret basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all area of effect abilities from champions. Counter Strike can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
